// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
// Replacement for test/language/types/reference/get-value-prop-base-primitive-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;

other.Number.prototype.test262 = 'number prototype';
other.value = 1;
assert.sameValue(other.$262.evalScript('value.test262'), 'number prototype');

other.String.prototype.test262 = 'string prototype';
other.value = '';
assert.sameValue(other.$262.evalScript('value.test262'), 'string prototype');

other.Boolean.prototype.test262 = 'Boolean prototype';
other.value = true;
assert.sameValue(other.$262.evalScript('value.test262'), 'Boolean prototype');

other.Symbol.prototype.test262 = 'Symbol prototype';
other.value = Symbol();
assert.sameValue(other.$262.evalScript('value.test262'), 'Symbol prototype');
})();

// Replacement for test/language/types/reference/put-value-prop-base-primitive-realm.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var numberCount = 0;
var stringCount = 0;
var booleanCount = 0;
var symbolCount = 0;
var spy;

spy = new Proxy({}, { set: function() { numberCount += 1; return true; } });
Object.setPrototypeOf(other.Number.prototype, spy);
other.$262.evalScript('0..test262 = null;');
assert.sameValue(numberCount, 1, 'number');

spy = new Proxy({}, { set: function() { stringCount += 1; return true; } });
Object.setPrototypeOf(other.String.prototype, spy);
other.$262.evalScript('"".test262 = null;');
assert.sameValue(stringCount, 1, 'string');

spy = new Proxy({}, { set: function() { booleanCount += 1; return true; } });
Object.setPrototypeOf(other.Boolean.prototype, spy);
other.$262.evalScript('true.test262 = null;');
assert.sameValue(booleanCount, 1, 'string');

spy = new Proxy({}, { set: function() { symbolCount += 1; return true; } });
Object.setPrototypeOf(other.Symbol.prototype, spy);
other.$262.evalScript('Symbol().test262 = null;');
assert.sameValue(symbolCount, 1, 'string');
})();

console.log("DS19 primitive-reference complete");
